verdicts.issue: Explanation says Children of Heaven was nominated 'at the 1999 Oscars' — the 71st Academy Awards ceremony was March 1999 but honoured 1998 films; in standard usage Iranian Wikipedia and most sources call it the 1998 nomination. Minor inconsistency; the more accurate phrasing avoids the ambiguity.

fix.explanation: Majid Majidi's Children of Heaven (1997) was nominated for Best Foreign Language Film at the 71st Academy Awards (held March 1999, honouring 1998 releases) — the first Iranian film ever nominated.

verdicts.issue: Question claims Anousheh Ansari was 'the first Muslim woman in space'. Wikipedia does not assert this; the verifiable claim is 'first Iranian (and first self-funded woman) on the ISS'. Some popular sources do call her the first Muslim woman in space but it's contested. Softening to verified facts.

fix.question: In September 2006, this Iranian-American businesswoman became the first Iranian in space, flying to the ISS as a self-funded spaceflight participant on a Soyuz. Name her.
fix.explanation: Anousheh Ansari flew to the ISS on Soyuz TMA-9 in September 2006. The Ansari X Prize is named after her family.
